en.name: ApexMarketWatch
en.subtitle: Quotes, charts and 13F filings
en.short_description: Market quotes and charts, plus what the big funds filed with the SEC.
en.description:
ApexMarketWatch is a market watchlist that shows you its sources.

WATCHLIST
Add the tickers you care about and see the last price in the listing's own currency, the day's move and a one-day sparkline. Tap through for the day's high and low, the 52-week range, and a price chart over the range you pick.

13F WHALES
Institutional holdings read straight from SEC EDGAR — gross buying, gross selling, and what changed. The SEC's public filing data, not a newsletter's summary of it.

CRASH INDEX
A market-wide 0–100 stress reading built from four public inputs: the VIX level, the VIX against its past-month average, the S&P 500's drop from its 1-year high, and net selling in the tracked funds' latest 13F filings. Every input and weight is shown on screen. It is a transparent heuristic, not a prediction.

HONEST PROVENANCE
Every screen labels where its numbers came from and how old they are. Quotes and charts come from Yahoo Finance and are exchange-delayed, so the app labels them Delayed and shows the exchange's own timestamp. When a source is unavailable the app says so rather than quietly showing you something stale.

NOT ADVICE
ApexMarketWatch reports public market data. It does not recommend trades, hold your money, or connect to a broker.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
ApexMarketWatch is a market watchlist that shows you its sources.

Intended audience:
Quotes, charts and 13F filings

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Crashlytics (Google) — crash reporting
- Yahoo Finance (query1.finance.yahoo.com) — public quote, chart and symbol-search data; no account or key
- SEC EDGAR (data.sec.gov, www.sec.gov) — public 13F filings; no account or key
The app has no backend of its own. Requests to Yahoo Finance carry only the ticker symbols and search text needed to answer them; requests to SEC EDGAR carry none.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app is in English only. Features are identical in every region. Quotes for non-US listings are shown in the listing's own currency.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
